chunks: From him, from his brother al-Ḥasan, from Zur‘ah, from Samā‘ah, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام about a man who touches his penis, or his private part, or lower than that, while he is standing performing salat (prayer): should he repeat his wudu (ablution)? He said: “There is no harm in that; it is only a part of his body.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; no legal problem

ai.seo_question: Does touching the private parts during salat (prayer) invalidate wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that touching one’s private parts during salat (prayer) does not invalidate wudu (ablution). The Imam عليه السلام explains the ruling by stating that it is merely part of one’s own body, indicating that such contact does not necessitate renewing ritual purity.
